display_name: Crisis 2028: Suwalki Corridor High-Intensity Armored Breach
briefing_opord: OPORD 28-102: OPFOR 1st Guards Tank Army launches an armored pincer across the 65-mile Suwalki Gap to link Belarus with Kaliningrad. Heavy Krasukha-4 Electronic Warfare blankets the corridor, severing GPS and datalinks. NATO Enhanced Forward Presence (Leopard 2A8, Bradley IFVs, Milrem THeMIS UGVs, and Rafale F4) must execute active defense and air-ground coordination to prevent the isolation of the Baltic states.
key_features: S-400 vs Rafale F4 SEAD duels
